values.note: Sagola Township: $30 a night for Dickinson County residents and non-residents alike; monthly $500 resident, $600 non-resident. Rustic camping with no electric or water $15 a night (rustic tent sites 'coming soon'). Showers, dump station and boat launch free to campers.

fees.source: https://sagolatownship.com/parks/ (Park Rates: 'Dickinson Country Residents $30/Night', 'Non-Dickinson County Residents $30/Night', 'Dickinson Country Residents $500/Month', 'Non-Dickinson County Residents $600/Month', 'Rustic Camping – no Elec/Water $15/Night'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://sagolatownship.com/parks/ ('30 campsites, all with 50 amp power'), read 2026-10-25

sites.source: https://sagolatownship.com/parks/ ('30 campsites, all with 50 amp power', 'Rustic tent sites coming soon'), read 2026-10-25

note: Sagola Township park on Sawyer Lake near Channing (N12886 Sawyer Lake Rd, 25 acres); beach with good swimming, boat launch, pavilion, playground. Campground hosts on site May 11 - Oct 1 (2026 schedule); by reservation through the host. --Claude
summary: Township parks page (the old sagolatwp.com link redirects to it): confirmed $30/night (same for non-residents; added monthly rates), 30 sites, showers; electric 30 -> 50 A ('all with 50 amp power'); added dump station. Booking and season not stated on the page (left as is). Monthly stays offered, no count of monthly sites (passes test 4). Note's '30-amp' corrected and field facts trimmed.
flags: Website: the stored https://sagolatwp.com/parks.htm redirects to https://sagolatownship.com/parks/ (section 'Newberg Park Campground', anchor https://sagolatownship.com/parks/#Newberg-Park); there is no separate park page. Use the new URL.
Name: the township calls it 'Newberg Park Campground' (Sagola Township), not 'Newberg Township Park (Gust Newberg Park)'.
